6.asc: Sun: In times of crisis when all those around are confused and in disorder, the ability not to succumb to the panic but to have the will and vitality to survive it alone
6.desc: Pluto: Curiously, the same gift, but one by its attitude that invites disapproval that in the extreme may even prevent a successful separation

1.name: Gate 52 Line 1 - Think before you speak
1.asc: Earth: The pause that is so profound that it leads to silence
1.desc: Mars: Speaking first and living with the consequences afterwards

2.name: Gate 52 Line 2 - Concern
2.asc: Venus: The pause that is initiated to benefit others
2.desc: Mars: A selfish and abrupt pause that may endanger others unnecessarily

3.name: Gate 52 Line 3 - Controls
3.asc: Saturn: The ability by its very nature to understand restraint with the potential in acceptance, to use the period to redefine strategies
3.desc: Venus: A deep dissatisfaction with controls that disturb tranquillity, leads to emotional withdrawel and affects vision

4.name: Gate 52 Line 4 - Self-discipline
4.asc: Saturn: Perfected self-discipline and restraint that deals easily and with impulsive temptations
4.desc: Jupiter: Though responsive to the need of a principled control based on the understanding of conditions, there is a tendency due to its natural expansiveness, to doubt and restlessness

5.name: Gate 52 Line 5 - Explanation
5.asc: Earth: The often terse but exceedingly accurate statement
5.desc: Pluto: A convolution whose enigmatic nature is normally misunderstood with unpredictable circumstances

6.name: Gate 52 Line 6 - Peacefulness
6.asc: Venus: A harmonic and balanced attunement that is at ease regardless of the situation
6.desc: Neptune: Delusion as a substitute for genuine tranquillity. Given the positive nature of this position, the delusion may be just as effective as the 'real thing'

1.name: Gate 53 Line 1 - Accumulation
1.asc: Neptune: The dissolution of old forms but not at the expense of valued components that will be retained and transformed
1.desc: Venus: Development hampered by criticism and the tendency to withdraw rather than make use of these experiences

2.name: Gate 53 Line 2 - Momentum
2.asc: Moon: The protection of early success nurtures further achievement
2.desc: Mars: A tendency with early success to haste and imprudent action

3.name: Gate 53 Line 3 - Practicality
3.asc: Moon: In its most natural position, the concentration on avoiding conflict to ensure protection and continued development
3.desc: Mars: The unconscious provoking of conflict that logically threatens security and development

4.name: Gate 53 Line 4 - Assuredness
4.asc: Moon: The ability to maintain the strength of one's individuality in complex and often awkward situations, that ensure continued security and development
4.desc: Venus: The persistent difficulty with embarrassing or awkward situations where normal emotional reactions may prove detrimental

5.name: Gate 53 Line 5 - Assertion
5.asc: Neptune: The underlying and often psychic recognition of the intrinsic values of development, that even in periods of isolation, has the assertiveness to maintain direction. Its very power garners continued support even from those who are basically opposed
5.desc: Earth: An over-assertiveness, that rather than applied to maintaining support in the face of opposition and isolation, may actually strengthen the opposing forces by its attitude

6.name: Gate 53 Line 6 - Phasing
6.asc: Moon: The successful utilization of the completion of a stage in development, that by its evident success and value can be used as an example to attract support for the next stage
6.desc: Pluto: A tendency in this position, to hide success, in the perverse fear that the success will either create excessive demands or supporters of the original process will end their support upon completion

1.name: Gate 54 Line 1 - Influence
1.asc: Pluto: The ability to achieve influence through secret relationships, anywhere from the private adviser to the satanist
1.desc: Venus: A socially misguided insistence on formal recognition of a relationship, that in terms of influence, will diminish its power

2.name: Gate 54 Line 2 - Discretion
2.asc: Saturn: The wisdom once a relationship is formally recognized to restrain the temptation to take advantage of past informal interactions
2.desc: Mars: Recognition, in the formal sense, seen as a licence to take advantage of informal knowledge. A lack of loyalty

3.name: Gate 54 Line 3 - Covert interaction
3.asc: Pluto: The ability when stymied in formal relationships to use secret or purely psychic channels, when it is the only resort
3.desc: Venus: The insistence that formal channels, no matter how frustrating, can be overcome by the power of attraction

4.name: Gate 54 Line 4 - Enlightenment Endarkenment
4.asc: No exaltation defined
4.desc: No detriment defined

5.name: Gate 54 Line 5 - Magnanimity
5.asc: Sun: The natural authority and actualizing spirit, that in a position of power, can have genuine and fruitful relationships with the less advantaged. (As long as they are in service and make no demands.)
5.desc: No detriment defined

6.name: Gate 54 Line 6 - Selectivity
6.asc: Saturn: The ingrained responsibility, in terms of maintaining security and personal identity that will naturally restrict its relationships to ones that are mutually beneficial
6.desc: Jupiter: A generally benefic and expansive nature that assumes that it can instill, what is otherwise missing in its partners. A waste of energy

1.name: Gate 55 Line 1 - Co-operation
1.asc: Jupiter: The expansion of activity through co-operation with powerful forces through principled actions that guarantee continued support and engender prosperity
1.desc: Venus: The concentration on harmonic relationships with powerful forces that provide for continuity but not necessarily advancement

2.name: Gate 55 Line 2 - Distrust
2.asc: Venus: The gift of being able to penetrate to the center that may demonstrate effectively through its relating talents, that its trustfullness is genuine
2.desc: Earth: The direct challenge to the slanderers who will always have the advantage of quoting the Bard: 'Methinks he doth protest too much.' Only continued example can overcome distrust

3.name: Gate 55 Line 3 - Innocence
3.asc: Saturn: When the form is correct and attempts at actualization have been disciplined and within guidelines, failure cannot be personally attributed
3.desc: Mars: Where a struggle against conformity or individual initiative can bring a superior to ruin while safely hiding behind his shield

4.name: Gate 55 Line 4 - Assimilation
4.asc: Jupiter: The establishment of a framework that balances principles with energy and leads inevitably to expansion and prosperity
4.desc: Mars: Boundless energy that knows no restraint

5.name: Gate 55 Line 5 - Growth
5.asc: Uranus: The unusual ability in a position of power to accept advice and transform it innovatively. This gift in a position of power allows one to continue to lead rather than being perceived as being led
5.desc: Sun: An integrative openness that in its broad acceptance of advice may be eventually eclipsed

6.name: Gate 55 Line 6 - Selfishness
6.asc: Saturn: Acquisition obsession that though alienating, is still indirectly beneficial materially to others
6.desc: Moon: Where the material abundance exists, but no one gets to share its light. The 'no Moon' phase

1.name: Gate 56 Line 1 - Quality
1.asc: Moon: The practical sense that even short term activities should be of value
1.desc: Mars: The ego drive to just make it, that will misuse energy in trivial pursuits

2.name: Gate 56 Line 2 - Linkage
2.asc: Uranus: Isolated genius that will eventually find continuity through recognition and support
2.desc: Moon: A superficiality which collapses under recognition and is eventually forced to move on

3.name: Gate 56 Line 3 - Alienation
3.asc: Sun: A will and egoism that often proves overbearing and guarantees continued isolation. Here, this is acceptable given the Sun's intrinsic vitality
3.desc: Venus: The reserved aesthetic that offends others, ensures isolation, and eliminates support

4.name: Gate 56 Line 4 - Expediency
4.asc: Moon: The perfection of the superficial personality, that can mask, when essential, its true feelings to secure protection
4.desc: Mercury: Expedient behaviour whose price is a constant stressful alertness and nervous anxiety in fear of losing what has been gained

5.name: Gate 56 Line 5 - Attracting attention
5.asc: Uranus: Unusualness, innovation and sometimes genius as guarantees of eventually attracting attention and support
5.desc: Mars: All too often the tendency to attract attention that is self-defeating in its effects

6.name: Gate 56 Line 6 - Caution
6.asc: Sun: The prudence, when linkage has been achieved, to honour its new commitments in order to secure its footing
6.desc: Pluto: The profound unconscious wanderer, where external yearning for acceptance will unconsciously release the exact energy that creates rejection. A difficult role, where the self is unknown and not recognized with predictable results

1.name: Gate 57 Line 1 - Confusion
1.asc: Venus: The gift of penetrating to the inner meaning that ensures timely action
1.desc: Moon: where feelings are no substitute for clarity and can lead to indecision

2.name: Gate 57 Line 2 - Cleansing
2.asc: Venus: Perfected cleansing through inner realization
2.desc: Moon: A superficial cleansing that tends to hide the dirt underneath the carpet

3.name: Gate 57 Line 3 - Acuteness
3.asc: Mercury: The perfected intelligence, where clarity eliminates doubt and ensures manifestation
3.desc: No detriment defined

4.name: Gate 57 Line 4 - The director
4.asc: Venus: The mastery of relationships that through clarity can maximize productivity while the sensitivity to interrelationships will ensure harmony
4.desc: Mars: A tendency given this position to be dictatorial rather than directorial

5.name: Gate 57 Line 5 - Progression
5.asc: Pluto: The natural ability to establish new forms while maintaining the powers of reevaluation and reexamination. This provides the clarity to examine the data and assess the process
5.desc: Moon: The tendency to keep on keeping on, that can end up as a misguided missile

6.name: Gate 57 Line 6 - Utilisation
6.asc: Uranus: The acceptance that clarity is a double-edged sword. There are situations where understanding cannot lead to rectification. Here, Uranus' innovative quality can generally make the best out of an otherwise difficult but rarely permanent situation
6.desc: Mars: When clarity points to a problem one is unable because of circumstances to solve, a tendency to anger and frustration that provokes inevitably futile action

1.name: Gate 58 Line 1 - Love of life
1.asc: Venus: The very stimulation of the world is the basis of an aesthetic appreciation of its beauty and wonder. Alone or shared with others this profound inner realization is the key for a joyous harmony with the process of being
1.desc: Moon: The Moon has its phases, its moods, that will limit joy to an intermittent and cyclical experience

2.name: Gate 58 Line 2 - Perversion
2.asc: No exaltation defined
2.desc: Uranus: A genius for perverse stimulation that afflicts oneself and others by promoting degeneracy and reducing joy to indulgence and decadence

3.name: Gate 58 Line 3 - Electricity
3.asc: Uranus: The individual whose electric vitality creates its own stimulation and is not dependent on others
3.desc: Mars: The quality of fire is dependent on its fuel and subject to its influence, good or bad

4.name: Gate 58 Line 4 - Focussing
4.asc: Pluto: A natural specialization that when confronted with a multiplicity of stimulations will have no inner difficulty in focusing on the appropriate influence
4.desc: Neptune: An impressionability that becomes confused when confronted with a multiplicity of stimulations and in trying to accommodate all of it, becomes unstable

5.name: Gate 58 Line 5 - Defence
5.asc: Moon: The natural and practical instinct to protect oneself regardless of temptations
5.desc: Sun: The assumption that the best defense is a good offense, that might allow strength of character to enjoy questionable stimulus without succumbing to it

6.name: Gate 58 Line 6 - Carried away
6.asc: Moon: The tendency to practicality that while thoroughly enjoying external stimulation has the instinct to draw back when its independent integrity is threatened
6.desc: Mercury: When its basic intelligence is effectively stimulated, its natural desire for attunement will lead it to identify so strongly with the stimulation that it is at risk of losing its identity

1.name: Gate 59 Line 1 - The preemptive strike
1.asc: Sun: The authority and vitality that in understanding purpose and direction can recognize and eliminate barriers before they become impregnable
1.desc: Mercury: In this position, the ability and intelligence to recognize, but a deep indecisiveness about how and when to act

2.name: Gate 59 Line 2 - Shyness
2.asc: Uranus: A preferred and natural separateness that protects against the inevitable instability engendered by union
2.desc: Pluto: A calculated shyness, rooted in deep psychological barriers, that even in dynamic individuals will always restrict interaction

3.name: Gate 59 Line 3 - Openness
3.asc: Saturn: Where the search for identity and security can only be achieved through the dropping of barriers, in order to define oneself through union
3.desc: Mars: Where openness is transformed into promiscuity and its attendant problems

4.name: Gate 59 Line 4 - Brotherhood Sisterhood
4.asc: Venus: The dropping of barriers to union to establish a universal union
4.desc: Mercury: An intellectual understanding that is rarely put into action

5.name: Gate 59 Line 5 - The Femme Fatale or Casanova
5.asc: Sun: The power to use love to break down any barrier. Given the Sun's 'lightness' there is no negative connotation inherent in this description
5.desc: Uranus: Where the negative potential of this power becomes evident. The Gigolo, the adventuress

6.name: Gate 59 Line 6 - The One Night Stand
6.asc: Venus: The perfected relationship whether for a moment or an eternity
6.desc: Mercury: The basic drive to move on, that seeks impermanency as a matter of course and not in response to circumstances

1.name: Gate 60 Line 1 - Acceptance
1.asc: Venus: The ability to maintain inner harmony when confronted by external limitations
1.desc: Mercury: The drive for diversity, that when limited can become restless and agitated

2.name: Gate 60 Line 2 - Decisiveness
2.asc: Saturn: The understanding of the nature of limitation, to accept its restraints when necessary and thus be able to take advantage of opportunities when they arise
2.desc: Earth: An adaptation to restraint that becomes habitual and maintains the nature of the limitation even when it no longer exists

3.name: Gate 60 Line 3 - Conservatism
3.asc: Saturn: Enlightened self-interest, that naturally handles restrictions and limitations ensuring identity and security
3.desc: Mars: Ego gratifying self-interest that ignores limitations and suffers predictably

4.name: Gate 60 Line 4 - Resourcefulness
4.asc: Mercury: The reasoned and intelligent maximization of potential within limitations
4.desc: Venus: A tendency in times of limitation to seek the inner meaning of the restriction rather than using its gifts to find a harmonic application within the limitation. The former leads to withdrawal and the latter to transcendence

5.name: Gate 60 Line 5 - Leadership
5.asc: Neptune: The awareness that the destruction of the old limitations simply creates new ones. This results in behavioural patterns that demonstrate this understanding through actions and enhances leadership potential
5.desc: Jupiter: Where the natural desire for expansion, when limitations are essential, creates confusion from the top

6.name: Gate 60 Line 6 - Rigidity
6.asc: Uranus: The intuitive intellect to recognize when absolute rigidity is essential but with innovative applications to lessen its severity
6.desc: Mercury: The dogmatic, principled and carefully reasoned understanding that is uncompromising in its severity and often coldly brutal in operation

1.name: Gate 61 Line 1 - Occult knowledge
1.asc: Neptune: A natural psychic awareness that empowers principles of universalization
1.desc: Venus: Where a reliance on secret knowledge increasingly demands ascetic withdrawal and leads eventually to obscurity

2.name: Gate 61 Line 2 - Natural brilliance
2.asc: Moon: and so gifted by this position a far-reaching, a nourishing influence, free of guile and powerfully attractive
2.desc: Mars: That in early recognition of its influence becomes ego obsessed with maximizing its effects

3.name: Gate 61 Line 3 - Interdependence
3.asc: Moon: The ability to establish relationships for the actualization of truths, and through their nurturing and protective power to ensure a stable environment in which they can continue to grow
3.desc: Mars: With an abundance of energy and in possession of a truth, the tendency to leave others behind or be crushed by their resistance

4.name: Gate 61 Line 4 - Research
4.asc: Saturn: The capacity of concentration to explore the depths of inner truth and maximize its application to fundamental principles
4.desc: Jupiter: Where the tendency to expansion and integration leads to involving others in the research and may end in a diversity of confusing applications

5.name: Gate 61 Line 5 - Influence
5.asc: Saturn: The enlightened Father figure whose recognized wisdom and powerful assertion can mold a generation by its influence
5.desc: Mars: A tendency in power to want to enforce compliance to ensure lasting influence

6.name: Gate 61 Line 6 - Appeal
6.asc: Pluto: The profound attunement to the collectivity that can lure the public to a truth
6.desc: Mars: A reliance on shop-worn cliches and slogans that may be new in their level of energy but inevitably fall on deaf ears

1.name: Gate 62 Line 1 - Routine
1.asc: Neptune: The ability to transcend the boredom of routine through a rich and daring fantasy life
1.desc: Mars: Rebellion and its enormous waste of energy

2.name: Gate 62 Line 2 - Restraint
2.asc: Saturn: The innate restrictiveness and discipline to comply with and exalt restraint
2.desc: Mercury: The intellect stymied by severe restraints tends to anxiety and restlessness

3.name: Gate 62 Line 3 - Discovery
3.asc: Uranus: A genius for the unusual. The ability to discover valuable information in detail work and to find innovative applications for this knowledge
3.desc: Venus: A dissatisfaction with the monotony of detail work, where what is missed may be of great importance and value

4.name: Gate 62 Line 4 - Asceticism
4.asc: Venus: The perfected ascetic withdrawal in the pursuit of harmony and simplicity, where outside dangers do not exist, and there is time to pursue inner meaning in detail
4.desc: Pluto: The urge to take action against established values that when restrained by circumstances, leads to withdrawal that waits for opportunity

5.name: Gate 62 Line 5 - Metamorphosis
5.asc: Moon: The reaching out to others to share, symbolized by the Moon's phases as it moves from darkness to eventually sharing fully its light
5.desc: Neptune: A tendency in metamorphosis to seek acclaim through dramatic presentation

6.name: Gate 62 Line 6 - Self-discipline
6.asc: Saturn: A penny saved is a penny earned. Detail as the path to material success
6.desc: Mercury: The skills but not the discipline to succeed

1.name: Gate 63 Line 1 - Composure
1.asc: Sun: The quality of personality where achievement is accepted with equanimity and where continued development is allowed to take its natural course
1.desc: Mars: The tendency in achievement to immediately seek new goals at the risk of destabilizing what has already been accomplished

2.name: Gate 63 Line 2 - Structuring
2.asc: Jupiter: The establishing of a large framework through which achievement can be expanded and shared; compensating others for their contributions while maintaining control of direction
2.desc: Uranus: Instability in achievement that when in positions of authority leads to arrogance and the desire to keep others away from the center of power

3.name: Gate 63 Line 3 - Continuance
3.asc: Jupiter: The dedication to the new beginning that insists on maintaining its achieved principles despite having to interact with those who have not attained such a state
3.desc: Saturn: Success at any price

4.name: Gate 63 Line 4 - Memory
4.asc: Mercury: The detailed accounting of the achievement process whose information base can prepare a new order for the future
4.desc: Mars: A willingness to forget in the glow of victory, with a possible price to be paid later

5.name: Gate 63 Line 5 - Affirmation
5.asc: Sun: The authority and sincerity of purpose to pursue the same values in the new beginning that had allowed it to transcend the old
5.desc: Mars: A tendency in triumph to pay lip service to such values, and given such leadership, these values will be reduced to nothing more than empty rituals

6.name: Gate 63 Line 6 - Nostalgia
6.asc: Jupiter: The good sense to avoid turning the previous struggle into an obsession
6.desc: Pluto: Revolutionary nostalgia

1.name: Gate 64 Line 1 - Conditions
1.asc: Venus: In penetrating to the center, the understanding that instills the necessary harmony to survive disorder
1.desc: Mars: The powerful temptation when having transition in sight, to hasty action

2.name: Gate 64 Line 2 - Qualification
2.asc: Venus: An inner development which recognizes what qualities are essential for transcendence and the awareness that without them, action will fail
2.desc: Moon: Constantly in action, it wastes the very qualities and resources that it will need

3.name: Gate 64 Line 3 - Overextension
3.asc: Saturn: The wisdom to recognize when one has not the necessary resources to complete transition. Such timely awareness may give it a chance to seek assistance
3.desc: Moon: The risk of a superficially confident personality that when transition collapses, there is no one to turn to

4.name: Gate 64 Line 4 - Conviction
4.asc: Moon: Symbolized by its phases, the Moon is assured of transition convinced by its very process that it will triumph
4.desc: Mars: Where force and energy alone cannot overcome doubt

5.name: Gate 64 Line 5 - Promise
5.asc: Venus: The values promised in any new order are demonstrated through harmonic interactions with others. This strengthens the justification for the struggle
5.desc: Jupiter: A tendency in trying to justify the struggle by focusing exclusively on the failure of the old order that cannot demonstrate the quality of the new

6.name: Gate 64 Line 6 - Victory
6.asc: Mercury: The mental assuredness, that knew that victory was inevitable, thus making triumph sweet but not reason for excess
6.desc: Venus: Like the story of the Trojan Horse, it can be dangerous to get carried away in celebration, lest one loses vigilance and perspective
